name: PAIX Abidjan
notes: Colocation facility listed in Bonoumin, Cocody, Abidjan; Datacenters.com lists 900 sq ft and access to 2.0 MW of power, while Baxtel confirms operational status and PAIX/NSIA background.

name: MTN Abidjan Data Centre
notes: Flexenclosure received an MTN Cote d'Ivoire order for a 336 sq m customized Abidjan data center to be installed by Q1 2014; later directory listing places MTN Abidjan Data Centre on Bd Francois Mitterrand.

name: STELLARIX Abidjan
notes: Data Center Map lists a STELLARIX Abidjan facility within the city; Africa Tech Festival profile says STELLARIX has facilities live or under development in Ivory Coast, but public source does not confirm exact Abidjan status or capacity.

name: N+ONE Abidjan expansion
notes: N+ONE official country page says it is bringing infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity solutions to Cote d'Ivoire and that more updates on its Abidjan expansion are coming soon; no site, capacity, or schedule disclosed.

name: Raxio CIV1
notes: Raxio inaugurated CIV1 at VITIB in Grand-Bassam on September 24, 2024; sources state Tier III certification, 2,000 sq m white space, up to 800 racks, and 3 MW IT power.

name: Equinix AB1 / MainOne AB1.2 Grand-Bassam
notes: Equinix lists AB1 at VITIB, Zone Franche Grand-Bassam. MainOne, an Equinix company, announced the open-access carrier-neutral Tier III AB1.2 facility in VITIB, building on the 2019 cable landing/data center presence; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Orange GOS Grand-Bassam data center
notes: Orange's Tier III-certified GOS data center in Grand-Bassam was built in 2016 on a 16,600 sq m site and offers 1.3 MW; DCD reported solar panels installed at the site in 2023.

name: ST Digital Grand-Bassam CIV01
notes: ST Digital lists a Grand-Bassam data center on its official Cote d'Ivoire page; DCD reports the facility opened after October 2, 2025, spans 4,000 sq m, and houses 160 racks and more than 6,000 physical servers. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Cote d'Ivoire Digital City sovereign data center
notes: Cybastion says construction began on a Digital City in Grand-Bassam anchored by a sovereign data center; EXIM says the national data center will be the central hub for government digital systems. Capacity not publicly disclosed.
